title: Obby Destoyer Barry
features: Functions (on the keys): * Z — Super-speed (you run faster). * X — Mega jump (you'll jump half the map). * C — REMOVE THE LAVA (The most important thing is that the script finds all the killing blocks and breaks them, now you can walk on the red blocks!). * V — Return everything as it was (normal speed and jump).
script:
local P=game.Players.LocalPlayer; local M=P:GetMouse()
M.KeyDown:Connect(function(k)
    local H=P.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if k=="z" then H.WalkSpeed=60 
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="HACK",Text="SPEED ON"})
    elseif k=="x" then H.UseJumpPower=true; H.JumpPower=120 
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="HACK",Text="JUMP ON"})
    elseif k=="c" then 
        for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then v:Destroy() end end
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="HACK",Text="LAVA REMOVED (GODMODE)"})
    elseif k=="v" then H.WalkSpeed=16; H.JumpPower=50
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="HACK",Text="RESET"})
    end
end)
